subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the five memory role slots, per-agent overrides, and hook-level role gating as the permanent public plugin contract?
rationale: The PR creates durable config keys, SDK types, hook semantics, defaults, migrations, and per-agent routing that implementation correctness alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor the role contract
options.body: Approve the role-based architecture in principle, then require conflict resolution and exact-head compatibility proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the initial API
options.body: Land only roles with complete runtime semantics and defer the remaining taxonomy or per-agent behavior.

options.title: Pause this architecture
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers choose a different memory-composition model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the role contract
recommendation.body: Approve the role-based architecture in principle, then require conflict resolution and exact-head compatibility proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available feature-history and API-governance evidence points here.
